address: 121 Dalin Road, South District, Tainan, Taiwan
bio: This shop started out as a tricycle food cart almost 50 years ago. Around the year 2000, it moved into the corrugated iron hut where it is still to be found today. It's often packed with diners craving not only the Taiwanese-style fish cake stew on its sign, but also bargain snacks, such as the famous small sausage in large sausage: pork sausage wrapped in a sticky rice sausage. The sticky rice is toothsome; ground peanuts provide crunch.
